<h2 class="section-title">India Markets</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">

<h2 class="section-title">Global Cues</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Monetary Policy Pressures:</strong> Market expectations for an RBI rate hike are intensifying following recent US Federal Reserve moves, making the upcoming October policy meeting a critical event for investors.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W10</a></span></li>
